scripts.desktop:dev:office: npm run build:electron && node scripts/run-with-dependencies.mjs concurrently -k "cross-env VITE_APP_VARIANT=office vite --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5173" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 && cross-env AI_DESKTOP_VARIANT=office VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron ."
scripts.desktop:dev:developer: npm run build:electron && node scripts/run-with-dependencies.mjs concurrently -k -n renderer,main,desktop "cross-env VITE_APP_VARIANT=developer vite --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5173" "tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 && cross-env AI_DESKTOP_VARIANT=developer VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electronmon ."
scripts.build:common: node scripts/run-with-dependencies.mjs node scripts/build-node-common.mjs && node scripts/run-with-dependencies.mjs node scripts/sync-node-common-runtime.mjs
scripts.build:electron: npm run build:common && node scripts/run-with-dependencies.mjs tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json
scripts.build:renderer:office: node scripts/run-with-dependencies.mjs cross-env VITE_APP_VARIANT=office vite build && node scripts/run-with-dependencies.mjs node scripts/prepare-sites-build.mjs
scripts.build:renderer:developer: node scripts/run-with-dependencies.mjs cross-env VITE_APP_VARIANT=developer vite build
scripts.build:renderer: npm run build:renderer:office && npm run build:renderer:developer
scripts.build:office: npm run typecheck && npm run build:electron && npm run build:renderer:office
scripts.build:developer: npm run typecheck && npm run build:electron && npm run build:renderer:developer
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build:electron && npm run build:renderer
scripts.start:office: npm run build:office && node scripts/run-with-dependencies.mjs cross-env AI_DESKTOP_VARIANT=office electron .
scripts.start:developer: npm run build:developer && node scripts/run-with-dependencies.mjs cross-env AI_DESKTOP_VARIANT=developer electron .
scripts.dist:win:office: npm run build && node scripts/run-with-dependencies.mjs electron-builder --config electron-builder.office.json --win nsis
scripts.dist:win:developer: npm run build && node scripts/run-with-dependencies.mjs electron-builder --config electron-builder.developer.json --win nsis --x64
scripts.dist:mac:office: npm run build && node scripts/run-with-dependencies.mjs electron-builder --config electron-builder.office.json --mac dmg
scripts.dist:mac:developer: npm run build && node scripts/run-with-dependencies.mjs electron-builder --config electron-builder.developer.json --mac dmg
scripts.package:mac:developer: npm run build:common && node scripts/run-with-dependencies.mjs electron-builder --config electron-builder.developer.json --mac dir && node scripts/run-with-dependencies.mjs node scripts/sign-mac-developer-app.mjs
scripts.test:common: npm run build:common && node scripts/run-with-dependencies.mjs node --test ../../shared/node/common-core/tests/application-paths.test.mjs
scripts.test:screenshot: npm run build:electron && node scripts/run-with-dependencies.mjs node --test tests/screenshot-store.test.mjs
scripts.test:stream: npm run build:electron && node scripts/run-with-dependencies.mjs node --test tests/codex-stream.test.mjs
scripts.test:workspace: npm run build:electron && node scripts/run-with-dependencies.mjs node --test tests/workspace-store.test.mjs
scripts.test:audit: npm run build:electron && node scripts/run-with-dependencies.mjs node --test tests/business-audit-log.test.mjs
scripts.test:dispatch: npm run build:electron && node scripts/run-with-dependencies.mjs node --test tests/conversation-dispatch-store.test.mjs
scripts.test:collaboration: npm run build:electron && node scripts/run-with-dependencies.mjs node --test tests/collaboration-mode.test.mjs
scripts.test:interaction: npm run build:developer && node scripts/run-with-dependencies.mjs node scripts/run-interaction-tests.mjs
